biomarkers.name: Molecular subgroups (supratentorial: ZFTA fusion or YAP1 fusion; posterior fossa: PFA / PFB; spinal: MYCN-amplified or NF2-mutant)
biomarkers.clinical_use: WHO CNS5 subclassification; ZFTA-fused and PFA generally have worse prognosis than YAP1-fused and PFB

biomarkers.name: ZFTA (formerly C11orf95)-RELA fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines a subgroup with worse prognosis; L1CAM IHC is an imperfect surrogate, with molecular confirmation preferred

biomarkers.name: H3K27me3 loss (PFA subtype)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in PFA subgroup; retained in most PFB

biomarkers.name: MYCN amplification (spinal)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines an aggressive spinal ependymoma subtype

biomarkers.name: NF2 mutations (spinal)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in spinal ependymoma, especially intramedullary tumors in adults
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with NF2 syndrome and also seen as somatic alteration in spinal ependymoma; NF2 syndrome predisposes to multiple ependymomas + schwannomas + meningiomas

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Perivascular pseudorosettes (tumour cells around vessels with cytoplasmic processes) and true ependymal rosettes; GFAP+, EMA dot-like positivity
variants: posterior fossa: PFA (worse, infants/young children) or PFB (better, older children/adults)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: WHO grade 2 or 3 for conventional ependymoma; myxopapillary ependymoma is WHO grade 2 and subependymoma is WHO grade 1. Grading has limited prognostic value compared to molecular subgroup

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Cold  like other primary CNS tumours
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Perivascular pseudorosette architecture; ependymal canals in true rosettes

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Radial glia and ependymal cell precursors along the ventricular system
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Ependymal / radial glial differentiation (GFAP+, EMA+ dot-like or ring pattern); perivascular pseudorosettes and true ependymal rosettes are characteristic
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Location + molecular subgroup define distinct entities: supratentorial (ZFTA fusion or YAP1 fusion), posterior fossa (PFA methylation subgroup  young children, aggressive; PFB  older, better prognosis), spinal (MYCN amplification, or NF2-associated)
